halfLife.notes: Oral flupenthixol t½ ~35 hours. CYP2D6 substrate. Used at low doses as an antidepressant augment; higher doses for psychosis. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Flupenthixol sulfoxide
activeMetabolite.notes: Sulfoxide metabolite has low activity. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors (e.g. fluoxetine, paroxetine) may increase levels. Monitor for EPS. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: FGA — lower metabolic risk than SGAs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Gradual taper recommended when switching from depot to oral. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Available as tablets for oral use. LAI form is flupenthixol decanoate (Fluanxol Depot). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
